livingCosts.notes: FALLBACK - visa minimum, not a University of Melbourne estimate: the Department of Home Affairs student visa living-cost requirement for a single student, AU$29,710 per year (from 10 May 2024) / 12. It is one combined figure for accommodation, food, transport and personal costs, so it is all in housing and the other categories are 0. Melbourne's own cost-of-living pages (study.unimelb.edu.au) block automated access and no breakdown could be verified; the amount was read from UNSW's page citing Home Affairs because the Home Affairs page also blocks scripts.
